# Show Sourcing: Help and FAQ

> The full Help text from the app, as plain text. Source of truth: https://showsourcing.app/help. Updated 2026-11-01.

## Getting Started

### What is Show Sourcing?
Show Sourcing records the products you find at trade shows. You take photos, add the vendor and the price, and the app calculates the landed cost. Your team sees every product on their own phones.

### Which devices can I use?
iPhone, iPad and Mac (the same app from the App Store), and Android (Google Play), all with the same account and team. On Windows or any computer, sign in to the web app at app.showsourcing.app; in Chrome or Edge you can install it so it opens like an app.

### How do I make an account?
Open the app and tap Get Started. Enter your name, email and a password. If you mistype a common email domain (for example gmial.com), the app shows a suggestion. It never blocks a company domain.

### Does the app work without internet?
Yes. You can create and edit products offline. The app saves them on the phone and uploads them when you are online again. Settings > Data > Sync Queue shows what is still waiting to upload.

### Why does the app ask me to update?
Some versions have a problem that an update fixes. Then the app shows a message with an Update button. Install the newest version from the App Store or TestFlight to continue.

### What keyboard shortcuts are there (Mac and iPad)?
On a Mac, or an iPad with a keyboard: ⌘1 to ⌘6 open Create, Products, Vendors, Team Map, Alerts and Settings. ⌘N starts a new product. ⌘, opens Settings. ⌘F searches the Products or Vendors list. On a product, ⌘← and ⌘→ go to the previous or next product, and ⌘E edits it. On a vendor, ⌘↑ and ⌘↓ go to the previous or next vendor. In photos, ← and → go to the previous or next photo, and Esc closes the viewer. ⌘S opens the status list (arrow keys and Return pick), ⌥⌘C opens comments and ⇧⌘E emails the vendor. On iPad, hold ⌘ to see the list. Arrow keys do not change pages while you type in a field.

### How do I find a setting?
Type in the Search Settings box at the top of Settings.

## Capturing Products

### How do I add a product?
Open the Create tab. Take photos, then fill in the vendor, FOB price and the other fields. Tap the check mark to save. The product goes to the Products tab and to your team.

### Can the next product start with the same vendor or category?
Yes, in three ways. To keep the vendor after every save, turn on Settings > Quick Selections > Vendor > Keep last vendor after saving. To keep the category after every save, turn on Settings > Quick Selections > Category > Keep last category after saving. To keep them for one product only, press and hold the save check on Create, turn on Same vendor or Same category, then tap Save. A plain tap follows your Settings.

### How do I take photos and videos?
Tap the camera button. Tap the shutter for a photo. Hold the shutter to record a video. Use the zoom dial to zoom. The thumbnails show at the bottom. Tap a thumbnail to crop or delete it.

### Can I add photos from my photo library?
Yes. On Create and Edit, use the photo menu and choose photos from your library.

### Can the app also save my photos to the Camera Roll?
Yes. Turn on Settings > General > Save to Camera Roll.

### Can I record a voice note?
Yes. On a product, use Voice Notes and tap Record. The phone writes the words as text on the device, so it works offline and the audio never leaves the phone for the transcript.

### Can the app fill in a product for me?
Yes. On the product page, tap Autofill (the text-in-a-frame button). The app reads the text in your photos and your voice note, then shows every suggestion on one screen. Keep the ones you want.

### Can I draw on a photo?
Yes. Open a photo and tap the markup button. Draw with your finger, change the color and the line width, and use the eraser. Your team sees the marks too.

### What are the chips above the fields?
They are Quick Selections: your common vendors, categories, tags, venues, MOQs and more. Tap a chip to fill the field. Change the lists in Settings > Quick Selections. You can sort them by manual order, A to Z, most used or last used.

### Does the app suggest values while I type?
Yes. When you type in a field such as Vendor or Category, a list of matching values shows. Tap one to use it.

### Where do I write notes about a product?
Use the Notes field on Create or Edit. It grows as you type new lines.

### How does the app know which show I am at?
The app knows the places of the big trade shows. When you are at one, it fills the Venue for new products. You can change the venue at any time.

### Does my team share the list of shows?
Yes. A venue that anyone adds, renames or removes reaches every phone on the team. Rename a venue in Settings > Venues. Products keep the venue they were saved with.

## Prices and Landed Cost

### What is LDP and how does the app calculate it?
LDP (landed duty paid) is the cost of one unit at your door. The app adds the price, packaging, the tariff and the freight share of one unit. Settings > LDP Calculation > How LDP Works shows the full formula with your numbers.

### How does the container cost change LDP?
Set the cost of one container in Settings > LDP Calculation. The app divides it by the Container Qty (units per container) to get the freight for one unit.

### What is the DDP discount?
It is a percent that the app takes off the duty part of LDP. Set it in Settings > LDP Calculation.

### What are FOB, CIF, EXW and DDP?
They tell the app what the vendor's price includes. FOB: the goods are on the ship. CIF: freight is in the price, so LDP leaves freight out. EXW: the price is at the factory, so the app adds an EXW cost per container. DDP: the vendor pays the duty too. Pick a term on each product. Set the default in Settings > LDP Calculation > Default Price Term.

### Why does a product show a dash for LDP?
The product has no price. Without a price the app cannot calculate LDP, so it shows a dash and leaves the product out of LDP filters.

### Can I enter prices in other currencies?
Yes. Pick the currency on the product. The app changes it to US dollars for LDP with daily rates. Choose your common currencies in Settings > Quick Selections > Currency.

### How do I enter a lower price for a bigger order?
Turn on Settings > Quick Selections > Price Breaks. Then tap Add Price Breaks under FOB on a product. Enter a quantity and a price on each row. The red minus deletes a row. The smallest quantity's price is the FOB.

### Which price break does the app use for LDP?
Settings > Quick Selections > Price Breaks > Display Cost. Lowest Qty uses the first row. Highest Qty uses the last row. The choice changes the price and LDP on the product page, in the list and in sorting.

### Can I change the quantities a new ladder starts with?
Yes. In Settings > Quick Selections > Price Breaks, edit Starting Quantities. Tap a row to change it, drag to reorder, swipe to delete. Each product can still change its own rows.

### I do not import into the United States. Is LDP still right?
Set your country in Settings > LDP Calculation > Destination. Choose the United States or the European Union, and the app uses that tariff schedule for duty. For any other country it hides the tariff rows and LDP has no duty.

### Where do the tariff rates come from?
From the official US tariff schedule (HTS), with Section 301 for China and the country rates. The team owner links each category to a tariff code in Settings > LDP Calculation > Tariff Codes. Then every product in that category gets that rate.

### How do I find the right tariff code?
In Tariff Codes, type what the product is, for example "led bulb". The app finds codes by meaning, not only by exact words.

## Finding Products

### What does search look at?
Vendor, category, tags, notes, venue, status, custom fields, the text printed in your photos and the photo descriptions. Spaces and capital letters do not matter, so "Heng Tian" finds "HengTian". You can also search with a photo: tap the camera next to the search bar. Tap the empty search bar to run a recent search again.

### Can I search with a photo?
Yes. Tap the camera next to the Products search bar and take a photo. The app lists your products that look like it. Press and hold the camera button to pick from your library or paste a photo.

### What is Visually Similar on a product page?
It lists products whose photos look like this one, so you can compare vendors for the same item. Hold a match and pick Not Similar to hide it for your whole team.

### Can I search for words printed on the box?
Yes. The app reads the text in your photos on the phone (free and offline). Type a word from the label and the product shows. Chinese text gets an English translation too.

### What is "Written from the photo"?
Apple Intelligence writes one sentence about each photo, for example color, shape and material. It helps search. It can be wrong, so the app never puts it into your own fields. Tap Redo on the product page to write it again. Settings > Data > Describe Photos runs it for all photos.

### How do I filter products?
Tap the filter button in Products. Filter by vendor, category, category group, tags, status, venue, team member, date, FOB, LDP, MOQ, comments and custom fields. Hold the filter button to clear all filters.

### How many products does my search or filter show?
The count shows under the search bar while a search or filter is on, for example "95 of 1,506 products". On the product page, "6/95" tells you where you are in that list.

### How do I sort products?
Use the sort menu in Products. Sort by date created, LDP, FOB, vendor, MOQ or status. Pick the same field again to reverse the order.

### Can I see products as a grid?
Yes. Use the Layout menu in Products to change between a list and a grid, and to change the photo size.

### How do I save product photos to my photo library?
Select products, tap Share, then Save Photos. Photos that are already in your library are skipped, so you get no duplicates.

### Can I change many products at once?
Yes. Select products in the list, then tap Edit. Fields that are the same on all of them show the value. Fields that differ show "Mixed". You can also delete the selected products.

### How do I move to the next product?
On a product page, use the arrows to go to the next or previous product in your list.

### What are Category Groups?
A group holds many categories, for example "Audio" holds Speakers and Headphones. Then you filter Products by the whole group. Groups can hold other groups. Make them in Settings > Follow Up > Category Groups. Your team shares them.

### How do I rename or merge a category?
In Settings > Quick Selections > Categories, swipe or hold a category and pick Rename or Merge. The change applies to every product on your team.

### Can I show products to a customer without the vendor names?
Yes. Turn on Settings > General > Hide Vendor Names. The app blurs every vendor name and keeps prices and photos.

## Vendors and Business Cards

### How do I add a vendor from a business card?
In Vendors, tap + and choose Scan Cards. Take a photo of each card. Tap Save. The app reads the name, company, phones, emails, WeChat, website and address in the background.

### Does card scanning send my cards anywhere?
The card is read on your device. With Settings > Privacy > Smart Card Reading on, only the card's text, never the photo, goes to Jev (TypeSafe) to sort it into company, contact, email and phone. Turn it off to keep everything on your device; check names and numbers after a scan then. Cards scanned offline are read again when you are back online.

### Can I add cards from photos I already took?
Yes. In Vendors, tap + and choose Choose Card Photos. Pick the photos, check them, and tap Save.

### What if I scan a card I already saved?
The app compares it with your saved vendors. If it finds a match, it shows "Already saved?" so you can add the card to the existing vendor and not make a copy.

### What do the green seal and red X next to a vendor email mean?
The app checks that the email's domain can get mail. A green seal means it can. A red X means it cannot, often from a misread card, and Change To offers the fix. An address at www.<domain> never gets mail, so the app offers it without the www.

### How do I add a vendor by hand?
In Vendors, tap + and choose Add Manually.

### Does the app know mobile, office and fax numbers?
Yes. Scanned phone numbers save as Mobile, Office or Fax from the words on the card.

### What is on a vendor page?
The contacts, phones, emails, WeChat, addresses, the card photo and all products from that vendor. Tap an email to write, a phone to call, or an address to open Maps.

### What are US shipping records on a vendor?
For US importers, the vendor page can show the vendor's shipments into the United States from public customs data. You can filter vendors by "US Customs data".

### How do I filter and sort vendors?
In Vendors, tap the filter button. Filter by show, category, number of products, country, who added it, date, and what it has (email, phone, WeChat, card photo, US customs data). Sort by name, date created, number of products, or by US shipments, containers and last shipment date.

### How do I merge two vendors that are the same?
Use Settings > Data > Merge Vendors. The app shows likely matches. Pick the vendor to keep. Its products, contacts and cards move into it.

## Working as a Team

### How do I make a team?
Open Settings and tap your account. Tap Create Team and enter a name. You are the owner.

### How do I invite people to my team?
Only the team owner can invite. In your account screen, tap Invite Member and enter their email. Inviting is free: the screen shows the seat price, and a seat is added and charged only when the person joins. They get an email and an invite in the app. If you are not the owner, ask your team owner to invite them.

### Who sees my products?
Everyone on your team. Products sync to all team phones in a few seconds. People outside your team never see them.

### Who can edit a product?
The person who made it. The team owner can also edit team products when "Owner can edit team items" is on in Settings > Team Permissions. The owner also picks who can export.

### How do I comment and mention a teammate?
Open a product and write in the comments. Type @ and a name to mention a teammate. They get a notification in Alerts.

### What is the Alerts tab?
Mentions, comments on your products and team invites. Tap one to open the product. Choose which alerts you get in Settings > General > Notifications.

### What is the Team Map?
At a show, the Team Map shows where your teammates are, with the direction and the floor. It shares your place only while the app is open and stops when you leave the show.

### How do I stop sharing my location?
Turn off location sharing in Settings > General > Team Radar. Then you do not show on the map and you do not see others.

### How do I see who added a product?
The product page shows Created By with the person's photo and name. You can also filter Products by team member.

## Fields and Settings

### How do I change the order of fields or hide some?
Settings > General > Fields. Drag to change the order. Turn a field off to hide it on Create and Edit. Vendor and FOB always show.

### Can I add my own fields?
Yes. In Settings > General > Fields, tap +. Pick a type (Text, Number, Currency or Toggle), a name and an icon. Tap a custom field to edit it. Your whole team gets the same custom fields.

### Can I search and filter by custom fields?
Yes. Search finds custom field values, and the filter sheet has a row for each custom field.

### Why do numbers use commas or dots differently?
The app uses your phone's region. For example 1,20 in Italy and 1.20 in the United States.

### Can I change the app color?
Yes. Settings > General > App Tint.

## Follow Up

### How do I mark where a product stands?
Set a Status on the product, for example Sample Requested. Edit the status list in Settings > Follow Up > Status. Your team shares the statuses.

### Can the app jump to the next product after I pick a status?
Yes. Turn on Auto Advance After Flagging in Settings > Follow Up > Status.

### How do I email a vendor about a product?
On the product page, tap the envelope button. The app fills in your email template with the product details and photos. Pick how it sends in Settings > Email Template > Send With: Mail App, Outlook, or Gmail when it is available. With Outlook or Gmail the email goes at once and the app confirms who got it. Add a CC there too; it syncs to your other devices.

### Can I email many vendors at once?
Yes. Select products, tap Share, then Email Vendors. After you confirm, the app sends one email to each vendor with that vendor's products and photos inline. This works with Outlook in Settings > Email Template > Send With (Gmail is coming soon).

### How do I know my emails went out?
Settings > Email Queue lists every email sent with Outlook or Gmail, with any error, and you can retry a failed one. Sent means your mail server accepted it. A wrong address sends a bounce notice to your inbox. Emails sent with the Mail app do not show there.

### How do I change the follow-up email?
Settings > Follow Up > Email Template. Edit the subject and body. Tap a chip to insert a field, such as the vendor name or the price. Pick your preferred mail client there too.

## RFQs (Quotes from Vendors)

### What is an RFQ?
A request for quotes. Make one in Settings > RFQs > New RFQ for each thing you are sourcing, with what you are looking for, up to 6 photos and target prices. Send vendors its link. They quote on a web form or an Excel sheet, with photos and a price for each quantity. What they send waits in the RFQs tab.

### How do I accept a vendor's quote?
Open the RFQs tab. Each item waits in To Review with its photos, price by quantity and LDP. Tap Accept to add it to Products, or Decline. Select several to accept or decline them together.

### What is the General Link?
One link that any vendor can use to send you products, without an RFQ. Find it in Settings > RFQs. Copy Link or Share sends it. Each item waits in the RFQs tab until someone accepts it.

### Can I choose what vendors fill in?
Yes. Edit the RFQ and open Form Fields. Switch a field on to show it, and tap the asterisk to make it required. A custom field's answer goes straight into that field on the product. You can also pick which categories vendors see and the quantities they price.

### Can vendors see my company logo?
Yes. Your team logo shows on every RFQ form.

## Siri and Spotlight

### Can I ask Siri to find a product?
Yes. Say "Find a product in Show Sourcing" and then say what to look for. Or say "Open <words> in Show Sourcing". The phrase must name the app.

### Can I find products from the Home Screen search?
Yes. Swipe down on the Home Screen and type a vendor or product. Tap a result to open it in the app. If results are missing, use Settings > Data > Rebuild Spotlight Index.

## AI Connection (ChatGPT, Claude)

### Can I ask ChatGPT or Claude about my products?
Yes. Settings > General > AI Connection makes a private link. Paste it into Claude, ChatGPT or another app that supports MCP connectors. Then ask, for example, "show me all speakers under $5". The AI can read your products and vendors. It cannot change them.

### How do I stop an AI app from reading my data?
In AI Connection, find the token by its name and tap Revoke. The link stops working at once. Each token shows its first and last characters so you can tell them apart.

### Does the AI see my photos?
Yes. When the AI opens a product, it gets up to 4 of its photos. In ChatGPT, products show as a grid with photos.

### Does the AI Connection cost extra?
No. You use your own ChatGPT or Claude account. Show Sourcing does not store your AI key.

## Data and Backup

### How do I export my products?
Select products, tap Share, then pick Excel, PDF or Save Photos. Settings > Backup & Import > Export Products (JSON) gives every field and a link to every photo. During the free trial and on the free plan, exports hold your first 10 products and 5 vendors, and the app tells you before it exports. The team owner can limit exports.

### Can I move my settings to a new phone?
Yes. Use Export Settings on the old phone and Import Settings on the new one, in Settings > Backup & Import.

### Do my settings follow me to my other devices?
Yes. Container cost, DDP discount, your defaults and your email CC sync between your devices. To move everything else to a new phone, see Can I move my settings to a new phone.

### How do I remove duplicate photos?
Settings > Data > Photo Cleanup finds photos that are the same and lets you remove the extra copies. It also finds photos that are sideways or upside down and turns them.

### Something looks wrong. How do I reload everything?
Settings > Data > Clear Local Data. It deletes the copy on this phone only. Nothing is deleted from the server. Everything downloads again and you stay signed in. First check that the Sync Queue is empty.

## Plans and Billing

### How much does Show Sourcing cost?
You pay per seat (one seat for each person). Yearly is $8.50 a seat a month. 6 months is $10 a seat a month. Teams of 10 or more get a discount. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Without a plan you can keep up to 10 products and 5 vendors for free. See showsourcing.app/pricing.

### What can I do without a plan?
You can keep up to 10 products and 5 vendors for free. When you need more, tap Start Free Trial at the top of the Create tab, or Profile > Subscribe.

### What happens when my free trial ends?
If you do not pick a plan, your newest 10 products and 5 vendors stay open. The rest are greyed out and locked, not deleted. Subscribe to open them again.

### Can I start paying before my trial ends?
Yes, if you own the team. Open Settings > Team Billing > Start Paid Plan Now. You see the exact price and card before you pay. If the card is declined, your trial keeps running.

### Why do exports and the AI Connection show only 10 products?
During the free trial and on the free plan, exports and the AI Connection use your first 10 products and 5 vendors. Start a paid plan for all of them.

### How do I add or remove seats?
The team owner opens Settings > account > Team Billing. The app shows the exact price and asks you to confirm before it charges for new seats. New seats cost a share of the rest of the period. Seats removed within 24 hours of buying them are refunded, unless the person on the seat added more than 10 products. Other removed seats give a credit on the next renewal.

### What happens if my card payment fails?
Stripe, our payment provider, charges your card. If a payment fails, update your card from the Stripe email, or write to support@showsourcing.app. You are charged only once.

## Help and Support

### How do I contact support?
Settings > Support > Email Support. The app attaches its log, which helps us find the problem. Or write to support@showsourcing.app.

### How do I try new features first?
Join the beta on TestFlight. Use the Join the Beta button on showsourcing.app/help. Beta builds can have bugs. Please tell us about them.

## API (REST and MCP)

Show Sourcing has two ways for your own code and AI tools to reach your team's products and vendors:

1. **REST API (v1)**: plain JSON over HTTPS. Use it from any language, script or no-code tool.
2. **MCP server**: for Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and other MCP apps. See [MCP server](#mcp-server) below.

Both use the same token. Machine-readable spec: [https://showsourcing.app/openapi.json](https://showsourcing.app/openapi.json).
This page as plain text: [https://showsourcing.app/docs/api.md](https://showsourcing.app/docs/api.md).

### REST API (v1)

Base URL: `https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/api`

All routes sit under `/v1`. Every request and response is JSON.

#### Auth

The API uses the same token as the AI Connection. One token works for both.

1. In the app (iPhone, iPad, Mac or Android), open Settings > AI Connection & API.
2. Tap Create token. To add data, turn on "Can add products and vendors". The app shows the token once.
3. Send it in a header on every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer ss_xxxxxxxx
```

`X-API-Key: ss_xxxxxxxx` also works.

A token is tied to one team. It can only see that team's data.
A token is read-only unless you made it with write access.
Revoke a token in the app and it stops working at once.

A token stops working when its owner leaves the team. Make a new one.

#### Plans

- With a paid plan, you see everything.
- On a free trial or with no plan, reads show only your first 10 products and first 5 vendors. The response has a `plan_limit` note.
- Adding data (POST) needs a paid plan or a free trial. With no plan, POST returns 402.

#### Routes

| Route | What it does |
|---|---|
| `GET /v1/products` | List and search products |
| `GET /v1/products/{id}` | One product, with photo links |
| `POST /v1/products` | Add a product (write token) |
| `GET /v1/vendors` | List and search vendors |
| `GET /v1/vendors/{id}` | One vendor |
| `POST /v1/vendors` | Add a vendor (write token) |

There is no update or delete in v1.

#### List products

`GET /v1/products?q=&limit=&offset=&updated_since=`

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `q` | Search text (max 200 characters). Matches vendor, category, notes, venue and the photo description. |
| `limit` | Rows to return. Default 50, maximum 200. |
| `offset` | Rows to skip. Default 0. |
| `updated_since` | ISO 8601 date. Only products changed at or after it. These come oldest change first, so you can page through changes. |

Without `updated_since`, newest products come first.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SS_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/api/v1/products?q=lamp&limit=2"
```

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "6f1c0a52-8d54-4a4b-9a43-0d7a1f3c9e10",
      "vendor": "Shenzhen ABC",
      "vendor_id": "95d5aa80-5433-487f-bbc1-29c3f2434d41",
      "category": "Lamps",
      "fob": 4.2,
      "currency": "USD",
      "price_term": "FOB",
      "moq": 500,
      "container_qty": 4000,
      "package_cbm": null,
      "country_of_origin": ["China"],
      "tariff_override": null,
      "tags": ["led", "desk"],
      "specs": "USB powered, 3 brightness levels",
      "venue": "Canton Fair",
      "status": null,
      "photo_count": 3,
      "photo_description": "a white desk lamp on a table",
      "created_at": "2026-11-01T10:00:00+00:00",
      "updated_at": "2026-11-02T09:30:00+00:00",
      "thumbnail": "https://api.showsourcing.app/storage/v1/object/sign/Media/..."
    }
  ],
  "count": 1,
  "total": 1,
  "limit": 2,
  "offset": 0,
  "has_more": false
}
```

`thumbnail` is a link to the first photo. It is set for the first 30 rows of a page. It expires after 7 days.
`photo_description` is written by a machine. It is often wrong. Do not treat it as fact.

#### Get one product

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SS_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/api/v1/products/6f1c0a52-8d54-4a4b-9a43-0d7a1f3c9e10"
```

It returns the same fields as the list, plus `photos`: up to 8 photo links (images only, no videos). The links expire after 7 days.

#### Add a product

`POST /v1/products` with a write token.

```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SS_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"vendor":"Shenzhen ABC","name":"LED desk lamp","category":"Lamps","fob":4.2,"currency":"USD","moq":500,"notes":"USB powered","tags":["led","desk"]}' \
  "https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/api/v1/products"
```

It returns `201` and the new product. The product shows up on the team's phones through normal sync.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor` | string, max 200 | Vendor name. If the team has a vendor with this name (case ignored), the product links to it. If not, a new vendor with this name is created. |
| `vendor_id` | UUID | Link to an existing vendor. Use this or `vendor`. |
| `name` | string, max 200 | Product name. The app has no name field, so it is saved as the first line of the notes. |
| `category` | string, max 100 | |
| `fob` | number, 0 to 1,000,000,000 | FOB price per unit. |
| `currency` | string | 3-letter code. Default `USD`. |
| `price_term` | string | `FOB`, `CIF`, `EXW` or `DDP`. |
| `moq` | whole number | Minimum order quantity. |
| `container_qty` | whole number | Units per container. |
| `specs` or `notes` | string, max 5000 | Notes (the app calls this field Notes). If you send both, they are joined. |
| `tags` | array of strings, or one comma list | Max 30 tags, 50 characters each. |
| `country_of_origin` | array of strings, or one comma list | Max 10. |
| `venue` | string, max 200 | Show or place. |

Send at least one of `vendor`, `vendor_id`, `name`, `category`, `fob`, `specs`, `notes`.
Other fields return 400 `unknown_field`.
Photos are not part of v1. Add photos in the app.

#### List vendors

`GET /v1/vendors?q=&limit=&offset=`

`q` matches the vendor name. Rows come sorted by name. `limit` and `offset` work as for products.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SS_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/api/v1/vendors?q=shenzhen"
```

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "95d5aa80-5433-487f-bbc1-29c3f2434d41",
      "name": "Shenzhen ABC",
      "contacts": [{ "name": "Cindy Liu", "title": "Sales" }],
      "emails": ["cindy@abc.example"],
      "phones": [{ "type": "office", "number": "+86 755 0000 0000" }],
      "websites": ["https://abc.example"],
      "wechats": [],
      "addresses": ["12 Example Road, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China"],
      "notes": null,
      "product_count": 4,
      "created_at": "2026-10-20T08:00:00+00:00",
      "updated_at": "2026-10-20T08:00:00+00:00"
    }
  ],
  "count": 1, "total": 1, "limit": 50, "offset": 0, "has_more": false
}
```

#### Get one vendor

`GET /v1/vendors/{id}` returns the same fields, plus `photos`: up to 4 photo links (business card photos).

#### Add a vendor

`POST /v1/vendors` with a write token.

```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SS_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Shenzhen ABC","contact":"Cindy Liu","email":"cindy@abc.example","phone":"+86 755 0000 0000","website":"https://abc.example","address":{"street":"12 Example Road","city":"Shenzhen","country":"China"}}' \
  "https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/api/v1/vendors"
```

It returns `201` and the new vendor.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string, max 200 | Required. |
| `contact` / `contacts` | name string, or `{name, title}`; or an array of them | Max 20. |
| `email` / `emails` | string, or array of strings | Must look like an email address. Max 20. |
| `phone` / `phones` | number string, or `{number, type}`; or an array | `type` is `mobile`, `office`, `fax` or `other`. A plain string gets `office`. Max 20. |
| `website` / `websites` | string, or array of strings | Max 10. |
| `wechat` / `wechats` | string, or array of strings | WeChat IDs. Max 10. |
| `address` / `addresses` | string, or `{street, city, state, postal_code, country}`; or an array | Saved as one line. Max 10. |
| `notes` | string, max 5000 | |

If the team already has a vendor with the same name (case ignored), the API returns 409 `already_exists` with the existing id.
Other fields return 400 `unknown_field`.

#### Errors

Every error has this shape:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "invalid_token", "message": "This token is not valid. It may be revoked." } }
```

| Status | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request`, `invalid_json`, `invalid_id`, `unknown_field`, `vendor_not_found`, `vendor_not_linked` | Bad input. The message says which field. |
| 401 | `missing_token`, `invalid_token` | No token, an unknown token, or a revoked token. |
| 402 | `plan_required` | POST with no plan and no trial. |
| 403 | `read_only_token` | POST with a token that has no write access. |
| 403 | `no_team`, `team_changed` | The token has no team, or its owner left the team. |
| 404 | `not_found` | No such route, or no such row in your team. |
| 405 | `method_not_allowed` | For example DELETE. The `Allow` header lists what works. |
| 409 | `already_exists` | A vendor with this name exists. |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | Too many requests. The `Retry-After` header gives seconds. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | Our side. Try again. |

#### Limits

- 120 requests per minute per token. Every response has `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.
- Request body: 100 KB.
- Photo links expire after 7 days. Ask again for new links.

### MCP server

The MCP server lets an AI app search your catalog in plain words ("which vendors had LED desk lamps under $5?").
You use your own AI account. We never see your AI key.

- Server URL: `https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/mcp`
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (not STDIO).
- Auth: the same token, as `Authorization: Bearer ss_xxxxxxxx`. Apps that cannot send headers can put it in the URL instead: `https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/mcp?key=ss_xxxxxxxx` (treat that URL like a password).
- Read only. The MCP server never adds, edits or deletes.

#### Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `search_products` | Search the team's products by vendor, category, specs, tags or photo description. Returns id, vendor, category, FOB price, MOQ and photo count. |
| `get_product` | The full record of one product, including LDP (landed duty paid, USD) and photos. |
| `show_products` | Shows up to 12 products as one photo grid (photo, vendor, price, MOQ). |
| `vendor_for_email` | Finds the vendor an email address belongs to (exact address first, then the company domain) and lists its products. |
| `list_vendors` | The team's vendors, with how many products each has. Optional name filter. |

#### Connect

- **Claude**: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector. Name: Show Sourcing. URL: the server URL with `?key=<your token>`. Leave the OAuth fields empty.
- **ChatGPT** (Mac app): Settings > Apps > Connect to a custom MCP. Type: Streamable HTTP. URL: the server URL. Under Headers add `Authorization` = `Bearer <your token>`.
- **Claude Code**:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http show-sourcing https://api.showsourcing.app/functions/v1/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $SS_TOKEN"
```

The app shows these steps with your real token filled in, under Settings > AI Connection & API.

### Help

Questions or a missing endpoint: support@showsourcing.app.

## Guides and comparisons

- [Sourcing trade show calendar 2027: dates for buyers](https://showsourcing.app/blog/sourcing-trade-show-calendar-2027/): The 2027 dates for the main sourcing trade shows: CES, Las Vegas Market, Ambiente, NY NOW, Hong Kong Electronics Fair, Canton Fair, IFA and Yiwu Fair, with links to a buyer's guide for each.
- [CES 2027 for sourcing buyers: how to find suppliers in Las Vegas](https://showsourcing.app/blog/ces-sourcing-guide/): How retail and brand buyers can use CES 2027 (6-9 January, Las Vegas) to find electronics suppliers: registration, pass prices, venues and a booth plan.
- [Yiwu Fair (China Yiwu International Commodities Fair): a buyer's guide](https://showsourcing.app/blog/yiwu-fair-guide/): How to visit the China Yiwu International Commodities Fair: dates, the free buyer badge, categories, and how to combine it with Canton Fair and the Yiwu market.
- [HKTDC Hong Kong Electronics Fair 2027: a buyer's guide](https://showsourcing.app/blog/hong-kong-electronics-fair-guide/): Dates, venue, registration and a booth plan for the HKTDC Hong Kong Electronics Fair (Spring Edition, 13-16 April 2027) at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.
- [NY NOW Winter 2027: a buyer's guide](https://showsourcing.app/blog/ny-now-buyer-guide/): Dates, buyer registration and a floor plan for NY NOW Winter 2027 (31 January - 2 February, Javits Center), the gift, home and handmade market.
- [IFA Berlin and IFA Global Markets: a sourcing guide](https://showsourcing.app/blog/ifa-global-markets-sourcing-guide/): How buyers can use IFA Berlin (3-7 September 2027) and its B2B sourcing event IFA Global Markets to find OEM and ODM electronics suppliers.
- [Ambiente 2027 Frankfurt: a buyer's guide](https://showsourcing.app/blog/ambiente-frankfurt-buyer-guide/): Dates, tickets and a hall plan for Ambiente 2027 (29 January - 2 February, Messe Frankfurt), the consumer goods fair for dining, living and giving.
- [Las Vegas Market Winter 2027: a buyer's guide](https://showsourcing.app/blog/las-vegas-market-buyer-guide/): Dates, trade registration and a plan for Las Vegas Market Winter 2027 (24-28 January), the furniture, home décor and gift market.
- [How to source products at a trade show: the complete buyer's guide](https://showsourcing.app/blog/how-to-source-products-at-trade-shows/): A step-by-step guide to sourcing products at trade shows like Canton Fair, Global Sources and the Hong Kong fairs: planning, what to record at each booth, comparing quotes and following up.
- [The trade show sourcing toolkit: what to bring and which apps you need](https://showsourcing.app/blog/trade-show-sourcing-tools/): A practical packing list and app list for buyers going to sourcing shows: power, cards, payment, connectivity, translation, and how to record products and vendors.
- [25 questions to ask suppliers at a trade show](https://showsourcing.app/blog/questions-to-ask-suppliers-at-trade-shows/): The questions buyers should ask at every booth, grouped by price, MOQ, product, factory, samples and shipping, with what each answer tells you.
- [How to follow up with suppliers after a trade show (with templates)](https://showsourcing.app/blog/follow-up-with-suppliers-after-trade-show/): When and how to follow up with suppliers after Canton Fair, Global Sources or any sourcing show, with email and WeChat templates and a simple process for hundreds of contacts.
- [How to compare supplier quotes: FOB, MOQ, price breaks and landed cost](https://showsourcing.app/blog/compare-supplier-quotes/): A worked example of comparing quotes from several suppliers for the same product, using price terms, price breaks, MOQ and landed cost per unit.
- [Global Sources and HKTDC Hong Kong shows: a buyer's guide](https://showsourcing.app/blog/hong-kong-sourcing-shows-guide/): How buyers can plan the Hong Kong sourcing shows held each April and October, Global Sources at AsiaWorld-Expo and the HKTDC fairs in Wan Chai, plus how they fit with Canton Fair.
- [Show Sourcing vs CamCard for trade show business cards](https://showsourcing.app/compare/show-sourcing-vs-camcard/): CamCard is a dedicated business card scanner. Show Sourcing scans cards too, and links each vendor to the products, prices and landed cost from their booth.
- [Show Sourcing vs Evernote for trade show notes](https://showsourcing.app/compare/show-sourcing-vs-evernote/): Evernote captures notes, photos and scans. Show Sourcing captures products, vendors and prices you can compare. A comparison for buyers at sourcing shows.
- [Show Sourcing vs Airtable for product sourcing](https://showsourcing.app/compare/show-sourcing-vs-airtable/): Airtable can be built into a sourcing database. Show Sourcing comes ready for trade shows. A comparison of setup, card scanning, landed cost, offline use and price per seat.
- [Show Sourcing vs the official Canton Fair and HKTDC apps](https://showsourcing.app/compare/show-sourcing-vs-official-show-apps/): The official show apps help you find exhibitors and get in. Show Sourcing records what you found and what it costs. Why buyers use both at Canton Fair and the Hong Kong fairs.
- [Show Sourcing vs Notion for trade show notes](https://showsourcing.app/compare/show-sourcing-vs-notion/): Notion is a great workspace for notes and docs. Show Sourcing is built for recording products, vendors and prices at trade shows. Here is how they compare for buyers.
- [Show Sourcing vs Excel and Google Sheets for trade show sourcing](https://showsourcing.app/compare/show-sourcing-vs-excel-google-sheets/): When a spreadsheet is enough for recording products at a trade show, and when a sourcing app like Show Sourcing saves time: photos, business cards, price breaks, landed cost and team edits.
- [Show Sourcing vs HubSpot CRM for buyers and importers](https://showsourcing.app/compare/show-sourcing-vs-hubspot-crm/): HubSpot is a sales CRM built around contacts and deals. Show Sourcing is a sourcing CRM built around products, quotes and landed cost. A comparison for buyers at trade shows.
- [Show Sourcing vs CardFlow Expo](https://showsourcing.app/compare/show-sourcing-vs-cardflow-expo/): An honest comparison of Show Sourcing and CardFlow Expo for buyers at trade shows: platforms, card scanning, products and prices, landed cost, teams and pricing.
